versions.mediaTitle: Listen to an announcement at a school art exhibit.
versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement at a school art exhibit.

Thank you for touring this special collection of paintings that we recently acquired from a donor. We're going to begin with late 18th-century works in the hallway on your left. We'll then proceed to early 19th-century in the next room, and finish with the modern art collection on the next floor. But first, I'll pass out a detailed map of the collection, which includes some artist information on the back.
versions.transcriptZh: 请听学校艺术展上的一则通知。男：感谢参观我们最近从一位捐赠者处获得的这批特别绘画收藏。我们将从你们左侧走廊的十八世纪末作品开始。然后进入下一间的十九世纪初作品，最后到下一层的现代艺术收藏。但首先，我会分发一份详细的收藏地图，背面含有一些艺术家信息。

versions.mediaTitle: Listen to an announcement in a university classroom.
versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement in a university classroom.

I'm pleased to announce that we'll have a guest speaker next week as part of our unit on environmental policy. Doctor Maya Chen will join us on Thursday, and she'll be speaking about international climate agreements, the role of youth activism and current challenges in global sustainability efforts. There will be time for questions at the end, so feel free to prepare some in advance. This talk should give you valuable insights for your upcoming group project, so please make sure to be there.
versions.transcriptZh: 请听大学教室中的一则通知。男：我很高兴宣布，作为环境政策单元的一部分，下周我们将有一位客座讲者。玛雅·陈博士星期四会加入我们，她将谈国际气候协议、青年行动主义的角色，以及全球可持续努力中的当前挑战。结束时有提问时间，可提前准备一些问题。这场讲座应为你们即将到来的小组项目提供宝贵洞见，请务必到场。

versions.label: Wofo M1
versions.mediaTitle: Listen to an announcement in a classroom.
versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement in a classroom.

This is the final course required for your business degree. The course will operate as an independent study. You will each select an area of focus that interests you. Some examples are available on my website. Then every week, you'll be required to submit short essays that respond to questions I give you on this topic. You'll need to refer to what you've learned in your other business courses, so you can cite theories or strategies that support your responses.
versions.transcriptZh: 请听一段教室中的通知。女：如你们所知，这是商学学位要求的最后一门课。本课将以独立研究方式进行。你们每人选择一个感兴趣的聚焦领域。我的网站上有一些例子。然后每周你们需提交短文，回应我就此主题给出的问题。你们需要参照其他商学课程所学，以便引用支持你们回答的理论或策略。

versions.mediaTitle: Listen to an announcement in a classroom.
versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement in a classroom.

For your upcoming project, please write a detailed report on a topic related to environmental science. It should be about 1,500 words long and include at least two scholarly sources. Please follow the university formatting guidelines. If you have any questions, my office hours are on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Just keep in mind, my office hours on the last Thursday of this month will be moved forward a day to Wednesday, because I'll be traveling to a research symposium.
versions.transcriptZh: 请听教室中关于你们即将到来的项目的一则通知。请写一份与环境科学相关主题的详细报告。大约一千五百词，并至少包含两份学术来源。请遵循大学格式规范；如有问题……我的办公时间在星期二与星期四。请记住，本月最后一个星期四的办公时间会提前一天改到星期三，因为我将前往研究研讨会。

versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement on a campus radio station.

Due to yesterday's heavy rain storms, a major leak has developed in the roof of the library. The campus facilities department has determined that it needs to be repaired as soon as possible to avoid damage to books and library resources. To allow for maintenance work, the library will be closed until noon on Wednesday. Some library resources will still be available online and study space will be available at the student center. The library staff apologizes for the inconvenience and appreciates your understanding.
versions.transcriptZh: 请听校园广播站的一则通知。由于昨天的暴雨，图书馆屋顶出现重大渗漏。校园设施部门已认定需尽快维修，以免损坏书籍与图书馆资源。为进行维护，图书馆将关闭至星期三中午。部分图书馆资源仍可在线获取，学生中心有学习空间。图书馆工作人员对不便表示歉意并感谢理解。

versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement at a school event.

We have an exciting opportunity for all fashion design majors. We'll be working with an up-and-coming business downtown that focuses solely on young adult clothing. If you're in your second year or higher, you can apply for an internship with them with the possibility of being hired once you graduate. They are also accepting design submissions for their company logo, and the creator of the selected design will be paid for it. Their website has all the details. I'll give you that URL now.

Listen to an announcement at a gathering of student club leaders.

The university is making some changes to the policies governing student organizations. One of these changes pertains to scheduling events at the last minute. This creates extra work for the student affairs office, and so effective immediately, all student clubs must submit their event plans to the office for approval at least 2 weeks in advance. Attention. The fitness center will be closing in 2 minutes. Please wrap up your workouts. Remember to return all dumbbells, bars, and other items to their proper places. As a reminder, we'll be closed for our cleanup tomorrow, but we hope to see you again when we reopen on Saturday morning, the day after tomorrow. Have a good night and a safe trip home.

versions.mediaTitle: Listen to an announcement at a university club meeting.
versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement at a university club meeting.

Attention club members. We wanted to make you aware of the new attendance policy that will be implemented starting next month due to ongoing issues with excessive absences. We will now require all members to attend at least 75% of the meetings each term to maintain their membership. Failure to comply may result in dismissal from the club. Allowances will be made for extenuating circumstances, and members can appeal a dismissal. Please visit our website to view the full policy.
versions.transcriptZh: 俱乐部成员请注意。我们想让你们了解下月起实施的新出勤政策。由于持续存在过多缺席问题，我们现在要求所有成员每学期至少出席百分之七十五的会议以维持会籍。不遵守可能导致被开除出俱乐部。特殊情况可获通融，成员可对开除提出申诉。请访问我们的网站查看完整政策。

choices.explanationZh: 网站只是用来查阅完整规定的渠道，原文没说网站本身有任何问题。这是把背景里出现的词（website）拽出来当原因。

choices.labelZh: 为接纳新俱乐部成员提供更多便利
choices.explanationZh: 新政策针对的是在册成员的出勤率，跟招新、放宽门槛完全是两件事——典型的偷换概念。

choices.explanationZh: 原文从未提到要参加什么"特别会议"作为惩罚，无中生有。

choices.label: Complaints from other club members

Listen to a university radio announcement.

Hello, students. Our end of semester celebration is next Friday at 6:00 pm in the student lounge. It's a great chance to relax before finals week. We'll have food, music, and a few games and activities, including trivia and a raffle with small prizes. Faculty from several departments will be there, too, so it's a great opportunity to connect with instructors outside of class. We still need a few volunteers to help set up before the event. If interested, please contact the student activities coordinator by Wednesday.

If you don't have a pair, you can rent them from the front desk. We'll waive the usual $5 charge this time. Also, the automatic scorekeeper can be tricky. If you're having trouble figuring out how to enter data, just press the question mark button on the screen. A staff member will assist.

Listen to an announcement in a classroom.

Quick reminder, Saturday's international club political debate on global aid is a must-attend for all of us. It ties directly into our readings on economically underdeveloped countries. After attending, you'll need to partner up with a classmate and prepare an oral presentation analyzing both sides of one of the financial issues discussed. I will email a list of available topics on Monday morning. For more details on the assignment, please check the syllabus.

Listen to an announcement at a university gym.

Attention students. Starting next week, the gym will be open from 6:00 am to 10:00 pm daily. Please ensure that you wear appropriate athletic attire and footwear while using the equipment. This helps us maintain a safe and hygienic environment and prevents damage to the machinery.

Good morning students. I have an important update regarding our classroom facilities. Starting next Monday, we will be using the university's new digital attendance system. versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement in a classroom.

Attention students. I want to explain the new campus recycling policy that will begin next Monday. Recycling bins for paper, plastic and metal will be placed in all academic buildings and residence halls. Items must be sorted correctly to avoid contamination. This policy is part of our effort to reduce waste and support environmental sustainability. We hope all of you will do your best to support a more sustainable campus. If you have questions, please contact the campus sustainability office.

versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement at a school event.

Beginning Monday, all administrative forms must be submitted electronically through the university's online portal. The change is designed to streamline processes and reduce paper waste. The Administrative Office will extend its hours, and students can contact the office by phone or email with questions.

versions.label: Wofo M9
versions.mediaTitle: Listen to an announcement in a university classroom.
versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement in a university classroom.

Good afternoon, students. Just a quick reminder about the upcoming deadline for your digital storytelling project. Final submissions are due next Friday. Your project should include a narrated video that combines images, voiceover, and background music to tell a personal story. Please use a common file format, and it's very important that all media used is either original or properly credited to the source. If you have any questions about the technical requirements or need help with editing tools, feel free to reach out.
versions.transcriptZh: 请听大学教室中的一则通知。发言人提醒学生，数字叙事项目的最终提交截止日为下星期五。项目应包含结合图像、旁白与背景音乐讲述个人故事的有声视频。学生必须注明来源，并可就技术要求或编辑工具寻求帮助。

versions.mediaTitle: Listen to an announcement in a classroom.
versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement in a classroom.

I want to remind you all that we will have a paper due every Friday. The paper should be a response to the week's reading, and should be at least 2 pages long. Papers should be uploaded to the class portal on Fridays by 5:00 pm. I will grade them and send you feedback by the end of the weekend. Late papers will be marked down by one letter grade each day, unless you speak with me ahead of time and receive an extension.

versions.mediaTitle: Listen to an announcement in a classroom.
versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement in a classroom.

Good afternoon, students. I'm sorry for the confusion regarding the deadlines for your upcoming assignments. As I wrote in this morning's email, the due dates on your syllabus are incorrect. Your research paper is actually due on Wednesday the 31st, and your group presentations are due the following Friday. I regret any inconvenience this has cost. On the other hand, this means you have some extra time to complete your assignments. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out during office hours.

versions.mediaTitle: Listen to an announcement in a classroom.
versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement in a classroom.

Students, I'd like to invite you to participate in a unique optional assignment. We'll be conducting a field study at the local nature reserve next Friday, observing frogs and sampling water conditions to see if water pollution has an impact on frog behavior. This is an excellent opportunity to apply what we've learned in class to a real world environment. It's free to participate, but we can only have 30 students, so don't wait to sign up.
versions.transcriptZh: 请听一段教室中的通知。教师邀请学生下星期五参加本地自然保护区的可选实地研究，观察青蛙并采样水体，以了解水污染是否影响青蛙行为。免费参加，但仅有三十个名额，因此教师敦促学生尽早报名。

versions.transcript:
Listen to a campus radio announcement.

The due date for submitting photographs to the campus photography contest is today at 3:00 pm. If you would like to enter but have not yet submitted a photograph, remember to do so today. After all submissions are in, selected photography students will judge the photos and declare a winner. The winner's name and winning photo will be printed in the campus newspaper. And all photographs entered will be posted on the university website next Wednesday.

versions.mediaTitle: Listen to an announcement in a university dormitory.
versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement in a university dormitory.

Attention residents. Based on communications with the custodial staff, we felt it was necessary to provide a refresher on the dormitory policies for trash and recycling. Please be mindful of the separate bins for paper, plastic, glass, and trash, and don't forget to sort before you dispose of it. Cardboard boxes should be broken down and placed against the wall. Lastly, please be mindful of materials that cannot be recycled. Lists of the most common items have been posted on each floor.
versions.transcriptZh:
请听大学宿舍的一则通知。

住户请注意。基于与保洁人员的沟通，我们认为有必要复习宿舍垃圾与回收政策。请注意纸张、塑料、玻璃与垃圾的分开箱子，并记得在丢弃前分类。纸箱应拆开靠墙放置。最后，请注意不可回收材料。每层已张贴最常见物品清单。

versions.mediaTitle: Listen to an announcement at a school event.
versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement at a school event.

I want to tell you all what to expect on tomorrow's field trip to Goya Nature Reserve. You'll start your visit in the auditorium. You'll get to hear from some experts in the field, including an ornithologist and a botanist. You'll take that information with you and use it to help you understand the wildlife you see while exploring nearby trails. Then after lunch, there will be two options: a mountain hike for experienced climbers only, or a trip to the tide pool for anyone interested.
versions.transcriptZh:
请听学校活动上的一则通知。

我想告诉大家明天去戈雅自然保护区实地考察会怎样。你们将从礼堂开始参观。你们会听到一些领域专家，包括一位鸟类学家与一位植物学家。你们会带着这些信息，在探索附近小径时帮助理解所见野生动物。午餐后有两个选项：仅限有经验登山者的山地徒步，或对任何感兴趣者开放的潮池之行。

versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement by a university administration.

We apologize for the cold temperatures in campus buildings today. Overnight, a large steam pipe failed. The entire steam distribution system must be temporarily shut down to allow for repairs to the pipe. Unfortunately, this means that most buildings are currently without heat and hot water. Science lab buildings have their own backup systems and should be unaffected. Please remember that the use of electric heaters is prohibited. These can overload buildings' electrical systems and cause a power outage. We'll update everyone when steam service is restored.
versions.transcriptZh: 请听大学行政部门的一则通知。行政部门致歉：因管道故障，蒸汽配送系统必须关闭维修。因此多数建筑没有供热与热水，不过科学实验室建筑有备用系统。学生被告知不要使用电暖器，因为它们可能使电力系统过载。校园班车将在宿舍楼与有供热的建筑之间运行，直到蒸汽服务恢复。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Narrator
transcriptSentences.text: Listen to an announcement by a university administration.
transcriptSentences.textZh: 请听大学行政部门的一则通知。

transcriptSentences.text: We apologize for the cold temperatures in campus buildings today.
transcriptSentences.textZh: 今天校园建筑里很冷，我们为此致歉。

transcriptSentences.text: Overnight, a large steam pipe failed.
transcriptSentences.textZh: 夜里有一根大型蒸汽管道出了故障。

transcriptSentences.text: The entire steam distribution system must be temporarily shut down to allow for repairs to the pipe.
transcriptSentences.textZh: 整个蒸汽配送系统必须暂时关闭，以便维修管道。

transcriptSentences.text: Unfortunately, this means that most buildings are currently without heat and hot water.
transcriptSentences.textZh: 遗憾的是，这意味着目前多数建筑没有供热和热水。

transcriptSentences.text: Science lab buildings have their own backup systems and should be unaffected.
transcriptSentences.textZh: 科学实验室建筑有自己的备用系统，应不受影响。

transcriptSentences.text: Please remember that the use of electric heaters is prohibited.
transcriptSentences.textZh: 请记住，禁止使用电暖器。

transcriptSentences.text: These can overload buildings' electrical systems and cause a power outage.
transcriptSentences.textZh: 电暖器可能使建筑电力系统过载，导致停电。

transcriptSentences.text: We'll update everyone when steam service is restored.
transcriptSentences.textZh: 蒸汽供应恢复后，我们会通知大家。

questions.promptText: Why are most campus buildings cold?
questions.promptTextZh: 为什么大部分校园建筑都很冷？

choices.label: A backup system is not working.
choices.explanationZh: backup system 指实验楼的备用系统，原文说它 'unaffected'——典型的偷换：把'有备用系统'扭成'备用系统坏了'。

choices.label: There is no electricity on campus.
choices.explanationZh: 停的是 steam 不是电；后文还担心电热器跳闸，反证电是通的。

choices.label: Temperatures are much colder than usual.
choices.explanationZh: 原文没提室外气温，冷的根源是楼内没暖气。

choices.label: A steam pipe broke.
choices.explanationZh: 关键句 'a large steam pipe failed... steam distribution system must be temporarily shut down'——管道坏 → 关供暖 → 楼里冷，因果链完整。

questions.promptText: Why is the use of electric heaters not allowed?
questions.promptTextZh: 为什么不允许使用电暖器？

choices.label: They can overload electrical systems.
choices.labelZh: 它们会使电路系统过载。
choices.explanationZh: 对应句 'These can overload buildings\' electrical systems and cause a power outage'——几乎逐词对应，原因就是 overload。

choices.label: They can affect lab experiments.
choices.labelZh: 它们会影响实验室的实验。
choices.explanationZh: 实验楼有自己的备用系统是另一码事，与电热器无关。

choices.label: Their use of power is too expensive over time.
choices.explanationZh: 原文谈的是安全（过载、跳闸），不是用电成本。

choices.label: Heat from them can damage pipes.
choices.labelZh: 它们产生的热量会损坏管道。
choices.explanationZh: 原文只提 electrical system 过载，没说热量伤管道——把上文的 pipe 硬拼到这里，张冠李戴。

versions.label: Wofo M12
versions.mediaTitle: Listen to an announcement in a classroom.
versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement in a classroom.

Good morning, students. We'd like to remind you about tonight's information session about the campus writing center. Past surveys of graduating students have found that fewer than half knew about the writing center, so we're trying to spread the word. We'll also have space in the library next term, so we'll be much easier to find. Our writing tutors can help with any stage of the process, from outlining to proofreading. Come to the campus center auditorium at 7:00 pm to learn more.
versions.transcriptZh:
请听一段教室中的通知。

同学们早上好。我们想提醒你们今晚关于校园写作中心的说明会。对即将毕业学生的过往调查发现不到一半人知道写作中心，所以我们在努力宣传。下学期我们在图书馆也会有空间，因此会更容易找到。我们的写作辅导可在从列提纲到校对的任何阶段提供帮助。晚上七点到校园中心礼堂了解更多。

questions.promptText: What is the main purpose of the information session?
questions.promptTextZh: 这次信息发布会的主要目的是什么？

choices.label: To survey graduating students about their experiences
choices.labelZh: 调查毕业生的相关经历
choices.explanationZh: 原文用 "fewer than half knew about the writing center" 这个调查数据来引出问题，目的是说"很多人不知道这个 service"，不是再做一次调查。

choices.labelZh: 提高对一项校园服务的认知度

choices.explanationZh: tutor 在原文里只用一句话简单介绍能帮哪些写作环节，不是把他们请到台上展示。

choices.label: To outline the process for reserving the auditorium
choices.explanationZh: 原文只说今晚 7 点 auditorium 见，是介绍活动地点，不是讨论 auditorium 怎么预定。

questions.promptText: What does the speaker imply about the writing center's current location?
questions.promptTextZh: 关于写作中心目前的位置，讲话者暗示了什么？

choices.label: It is too small for the center's needs.
choices.labelZh: 对于该中心的需求来说太小了
choices.explanationZh: 原文没有说当前位置太小或空间不足；"easier to find" 指的是位置难找，不是面积不够。

choices.label: It is housed within the library.
choices.explanationZh: "we'll also have space in the library next term" 说的是下学期会在图书馆有空间，不能推出现在已经在图书馆。

choices.label: It is difficult to locate.
choices.explanationZh: 正确。说下学期会在图书馆、因此 "much easier to find"，反推出当前位置现在不容易找。

choices.label: It opens at seven p.m.
choices.explanationZh: 7:00 p.m. 是 information session 的时间，不是 writing center 的开放时间。

versions.mediaTitle: Listen to an announcement in a class.
versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement in a class.

Hello, a couple of announcements. First, our scheduled studio time for this week will unfortunately have to be postponed. The space is undergoing unexpected maintenance and won't be available until next Wednesday. You can borrow supplies from me, though, and work on your projects at home or in the library art room. Better news is that we'll have a guest speaker this Friday, local artist Maya Lin, who will talk about her creative process and answer questions. She'll show some of her work too.
versions.transcriptZh:
请听课堂上的一则通知。

大家好，有几则通知。第一，本周原定工作室时间不幸必须推迟。该空间正进行意外维护，要到下星期三才可用。不过你们可向我借用用品，在家或图书馆美术室做项目。更好的消息是本星期五有客座讲者——本地艺术家林璎，她将谈创作过程并回答问题。她也会展示一些作品。

Welcome, trainees. Now that we've increased our building size, the bookstore has been busier than ever, and it's great to have you with us. We'll start by talking about stocking shelves. versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement in a classroom.

Let me tell you about something exciting starting next week. All our course readings, assignments, and lecture slides will be available through our new online platform. This should make it easier for you to stay organized and access everything in one place. Please create your account by Friday and take some time to explore the layout and features. There's also a tutorial video on the home page to help you get started. If you have any trouble logging in or locating materials, please let me know.
versions.transcriptZh:
请听一段教室中的通知。

让我告诉你们下周开始的一件令人兴奋的事。我们所有的课程阅读、作业与讲义幻灯片都将通过新的在线平台提供。这应使你们更易保持条理并在一处获取一切。请星期五前创建账户，并花时间探索布局与功能。主页还有教程视频帮你入门。若登录或查找材料有任何困难，请告诉我。

Attention students. Tonight's concert will begin promptly at seven in the auditorium. Please be at the entrance by 6:45 to ensure you locate the seat indicated on your ticket by the start time. versions.transcript:
Listen to a campus radio announcement.

Campus technology services would like to inform everyone of some exciting changes to our offerings. Starting next week, anyone whose laptop is with us for service can borrow a loaner device. Loaner laptops include the stack suite of campus software. There is no charge unless the device is damaged or lost. In addition, you will now need to swipe your campus ID to access computer labs between 10:00 pm and 9:00 am, since student staff are typically not present during these times.
versions.transcriptZh:
请听校园广播通知。

校园技术服务想告知大家我们服务的一些令人兴奋的变化。从下周起，笔记本在我们这里维修的人可借用备用设备。备用笔记本包含校园软件套件。除非设备损坏或丢失，否则不收费。此外，晚上十点至上午九点进入计算机实验室现在需刷校园证，因这些时段通常没有学生工作人员。

versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement at a school event.

Hello, students. Please come to the annual student fair this Friday and Saturday. The event lasts from 10:00 am until 7:00 pm each day. There will be booths showcasing various cultures and international street cuisine plus stage performances of traditional music from around the world. Please present your student ID for free entry. Tickets for non-students are available at the gate for $5. We hope you'll stay all day each day for a fun and educational experience. Contact the event organizers with any questions.

versions.mediaTitle: Listen to an announcement in a classroom.
versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement in a classroom.

Hi everyone. First, a reminder about next week. We'll begin our group presentations on Monday. Each group will have 12 minutes to present, followed by a 3-minute Q&A. Your pitch should reflect a clear understanding of client needs, competitive positioning, and team strategy. Presentations will be evaluated on clarity, collaboration, and responsiveness to questions. All group members must be present and ready at the start of class. Missing members may affect your group's grade. I'm looking forward to seeing how you've developed your concepts.
versions.transcriptZh:
请听一段教室中的通知。

大家好。首先提醒一下下周。我们将在星期一开始小组报告。每组有十二分钟展示，随后三分钟问答。你们的陈述应体现对客户需求、竞争定位与团队策略的清晰理解。报告将按清晰度、协作与对问题的回应来评估。所有组员必须在上课开始时到场并准备好。缺席成员可能影响小组分数。我期待看到你们如何发展概念。

versions.mediaTitle: Listen to an announcement on a university radio station.
versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement on a university radio station.

Students, starting next Monday, our career counseling office will update its schedule and offer extended hours for the spring semester. The office will be open from 8:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. on weekdays to handle the additional demand from students looking for summer jobs and internships, or preparing for work post-graduation. The career counseling office will also be merging with the office of volunteer services, so that assistance with both paid and volunteer work opportunities will be available in the same location.
versions.transcriptZh:
请听大学广播站的一则通知。

同学们，从下星期一开始，我们的职业咨询办公室将更新时刻表并为春季学期提供延长时间。办公室工作日上午八点至晚上七点开放，以应对寻找暑期工作与实习或准备毕业后工作的学生额外需求。职业咨询办公室还将与志愿服务办公室合并，以便在同一地点提供有偿与志愿工作机会的协助。

choices.explanationZh: 完全无中生有。整段在讲 career counseling，跟校内教学岗位没关系。

choices.explanationZh: 无中生有。原文没提收费与否。

versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement in a classroom.

Class, the textbooks for our course are on back order, and the bookstore isn't sure when they will be in. That said, I've identified an alternative open education resource. This means that there will be no cost for you, but the book will only be available online. Supplemental materials will be photocopied and distributed in class. And I'll also want your feedback at the end of the semester to determine whether the new book works as a feasible permanent replacement.

versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement in a university dormitory.

Attention students. We apologize for the lack of clarity related to the recent changes to our recycling program. Some of the labels were misleading, which led to some misunderstandings about where to dispose of certain items. Please make sure to check the updated labels on the bins. Please also see the new detailed guidelines that have been posted on every floor in each dormitory.

Regarding your interactive posters for the mid-semester project, I'm happy to share that our computer lab now features new graphic design software to support your work. This should help you with your task of designing posters that communicate complex concepts in a visually compelling way, like illustrating how climate policy decisions affect not just climate, but also global economic systems. The new software offers advanced capabilities in motion graphics and layout design, which will make it easier to refine your visuals and introduce dynamic elements.

versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement at a student club meeting.
Welcome to the inaugural meeting of our university's first pickleball club. I'm Robbie Vincent, volunteer president. Alex Rivera is our vice president. We still need a treasurer and secretary. Let me know if you're interested. Club officers serve for one academic year. We've reserved the four outdoor courts near the recreation center for 5:00 to 6:30 on Tuesdays and Thursdays, weather permitting. Intermediate pickleballers get the Tuesday slot, and advanced players get Thursdays. Eventually, we'll admit beginners and recruit volunteers to teach them.

versions.mediaTitle: Listen to an announcement in a classroom.
versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement in a classroom.

I want to announce some changes to our class schedule for the new semester starting in January. Based on the results of the student survey you took last month, our class will begin at 9:30 a.m. instead of 10:00 a.m., and each class session will be extended to 90 minutes instead of just an hour. Additionally, a lab session will be scheduled on Fridays from 2:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. to provide hands-on experience related to the course material. I'm pleased that these changes were approved.
versions.transcriptZh:
请听一段教室中的通知。

我想宣布一月开始的新学期课程安排的一些变更。根据你们上月所做学生调查的结果，我们的课将改为上午九点半而非十点开始，每节课延长至九十分钟而非仅一小时。此外，星期五下午两点至四点将安排实验课，以提供与课程材料相关的动手经验。我很高兴这些变更获批。

versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement at a school event.

Good afternoon, students. I'd like to outline some new procedures for campus administrative activities. Beginning Monday, all administrative forms must be submitted electronically through the university's online portal. This change aims to streamline processes and reduce paper waste. Additionally, the administrative office will extend its hours to better accommodate student needs, opening at 9:00 a.m. and closing at 6:00 p.m. These updates are meant to improve efficiency and accessibility for everyone. If you have any questions, please contact the administrative office by phone or email.

请听学校活动上的一则通知。

versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement in a university science lab.

Hey everyone, we've got some important updates to our lab safety protocols that you need to know about. Starting next week, there will be a mandatory training session for lab users. This is to ensure everyone's up to speed with the new safety measures and can work safely. Only those of you who first trained last semester or before need to attend. The rest of you have already received updated procedures. The training will take place next Thursday at 3 p.m. in lab room 204. If you have any questions or need more details, please drop by my office or send me an email.

Listen to a school radio announcement.

We wanted to update everyone on the recreation facilities schedule. Starting next week, the gym and fitness center will close two hours early every night for maintenance. Both facilities will return to their usual hours before the end of the semester. We will inform everyone when the work is complete. When the facility reopens, everyone using the courts in the gym will be required to change their shoes before entering the gym area. We suggest keeping an extra pair of shoes in your locker.

versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement in a university dormitory.

Attention residents. We would like to remind everyone of the shared responsibility for maintaining the kitchen. Beginning this week, any dirty dishes left in the sink on Sunday will be thrown out. Please remember that sponges and dish soap are available and are replenished daily by the custodial staff. In addition, please be sure to remove anything in the refrigerator that's past its expiration date, and don't forget to put your name on everything that's yours. If there's no name, it's considered communal property.

versions.mediaTitle: Listen to an announcement at a university club meeting.
versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement at a university club meeting.

The environmental club will be hosting a campus cleanup session Saturday, starting at 9:00 a.m. It's not too late to sign up, and the activity is open to all. Participants will spend two hours picking up trash around campus and will receive free T-shirts and refreshments. And next weekend, we'll be hosting the first-ever multi-university symposium. Student leaders from four different schools will discuss ways our students can work together to improve recycling efforts. The complete agenda is available on our club webpage.
versions.transcriptZh:
请听大学俱乐部会议上的一则通知。

环境俱乐部将于星期六上午九点起举办校园清理活动。报名还不晚，活动对所有人开放。参与者将花两小时在校园捡拾垃圾，并获免费 T 恤与茶点。下周末我们将举办首次多校研讨会。来自四所不同学校的学生领袖将讨论我们的学生如何合作改善回收。完整议程在我们俱乐部网页上。

versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement at a university club meeting.

In preparation for our next competition, the debate team will be holding a mock debate in the student center this Thursday at 7:00 p.m. The topic is whether the government should pass a law requiring all new motor vehicles to be electric. All are welcome to attend, and we encourage audience members to come prepared with questions for our debaters. And we have openings for more club members, so please tell your friends to check us out and see if they want to join.
versions.transcriptZh:
请听大学俱乐部会议上的一则通知。

为准备下次比赛，辩论队将于本星期四晚上七点在学生中心举行模拟辩论。主题是政府是否应通过法律要求所有新机动车为电动。欢迎所有人出席，我们鼓励听众准备好向辩手提问。我们还有更多俱乐部成员名额，请告诉朋友来了解并看是否想加入。

questions.promptText: What question would someone in the audience most likely ask?
questions.promptTextZh: 听众中最可能提出什么问题？

choices.label: What are the environmental benefits?
choices.explanationZh: 正确。辩论题是"政府是否该立法要求所有新机动车都是电动的"。台下听众针对这个题目最自然的提问就是"电动车有什么环保好处"——围绕辩题核心去问。

choices.label: Should public universities be free to attend?
choices.labelZh: 公立大学是否应该免学费？
choices.explanationZh: 偏题。原文辩题是电动车立法，跟公立大学是否免费没有半点关系。

choices.label: Should a law be passed to lower the legal driving age?
choices.labelZh: 是否应该通过法律降低合法驾驶年龄？
choices.explanationZh: 偷换辩题。"通过立法"这个词是原文出现过的，但话题是电动车，不是降低法定驾驶年龄。听到熟词别条件反射。

choices.label: What are the impacts of social media on children?
choices.labelZh: 社交媒体对儿童的影响是什么？
choices.explanationZh: 完全无中生有。社交媒体对儿童的影响和这场辩论无关。

questions.promptText: What does the speaker imply that audience members may be inspired to do?
questions.promptTextZh: 演讲者暗示听众成员可能受到启发去做什么？

choices.label: Propose a law
choices.explanationZh: 字面骗。原文确实提到 "law"，但那是辩题，不是号召观众自己提案立法。

choices.label: Join a club
choices.explanationZh: 正确。结尾 "we have openings for more club members, so please tell your friends to check us out and see if they want to join"——明显在拉新。听众被"启发"做的事就是加入社团。

choices.label: Submit a contest entry
choices.explanationZh: 无中生有。原文没提交比赛作品这件事。

choices.label: Vote on the debate winner
choices.explanationZh: 细节夸大。这是一场 mock debate（模拟练习），不是评比，没说让观众投票选赢家。

versions.transcript: Listen to an announcement in a university dormitory. Attention residents, we have a few important reminders for you. First, please remember that quiet hours run from 11 p.m. to 8 a.m. daily. We've recently received several complaints about noise during this period, so while everyone should know the policy, we wanted to provide a gentle reminder. Also, we have experienced an increase in broken laundry machines lately, meaning even longer waits for an open machine. Please remember to empty your pockets and shake out everything before placing it in the wash.

versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement on a campus radio station.

Good morning, students. We wanted to remind you about some recent updates to our campus shuttle schedule. Beginning next Monday, shuttle service will operate on a new extended schedule in the mornings, starting at 7:00 a.m. It will also add two additional stops to its route: the campus art museum and the Zimmerman Theater. These changes are in response to student feedback. We're always working to improve. Please check the updated schedule on the transportation office website and plan your travel accordingly.

versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement in a classroom.

Attention students. We need to inform you about updates to the course registration process. Starting next month, all registrations must be completed online through the new student portal. This change is intended to streamline the process and reduce paperwork. Please take the time to familiarize yourself with the portal, as it will be the primary method for handling course registration moving forward. Further instructions and a tutorial are available on the registrar's website. For registration questions not related to the portal, please see your advisor.

versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement in a computer lab.

Attention students. Starting next week, there will be some changes to our computer lab equipment usage policy. All computers in the lab must be logged out and shut down by 10:00 p.m. to allow for nightly maintenance of our systems. This will ensure that our equipment remains in optimal condition for everyone's use. If you plan to use the lab during peak hours, especially in the afternoons, we urge you to reserve a workstation in advance to guarantee access.

请听计算机实验室的一则通知。

同学们请注意。从下周起，计算机实验室设备使用政策将有一些变更。实验室所有电脑必须在晚上十点前登出并关机，以便我们系统夜间维护。这将确保设备保持最佳状态供大家使用。若你计划在高峰时段——尤其是下午——使用实验室，我们敦促你提前预订工作站以保证使用。

versions.transcript:

Hi everyone. At the town hall meeting in the auditorium next Wednesday, we'll discuss a new initiative. Starting next semester, students will be allowed to manage designated campus businesses for entrepreneurial projects. This is to encourage creativity, leadership, and hands-on experience. For example, the old library basement is already being converted into a cafe that will be fully operated by students, except that the menu will be designed by your professors. Yes, really. Three of our own faculty members previously worked as professional chefs.

versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement in a university dining hall.

Attention students. Join us at the composting initiative launch next Monday at 4:00 p.m. in the dining hall. Composting is the process of turning food scraps and other biodegradable items, like fruit peels, coffee grounds, and napkins, into soil instead of trash. The event will include a hands-on workshop on how to properly identify compostable items. The workshop will end with a game quiz on composting, and the winners will get free tickets to the environmental film festival on campus next month.
versions.transcriptZh:
请听大学食堂的一则通知。

同学们请注意。下星期一下午四点在食堂参加堆肥倡议启动活动。堆肥是把食物残渣与其他可生物降解物品——如果皮、咖啡渣与餐巾——变成土壤而非垃圾的过程。活动将包括如何正确识别可堆肥物品的动手工作坊。工作坊以堆肥知识竞答结束，获胜者将获下月校园环境电影节免费票。

Good evening, students. The annual campus film festival is being held next weekend. This event will feature a variety of films from different genres, including documentaries, comedies, and dramas. We'll also feature several films by local filmmakers, including one by a fellow student. Screenings take place in the university auditorium from Friday to Sunday, starting at noon each day. There will also be Q&A sessions with the filmmakers after selected screenings. We hope you'll join us for a weekend of great films and engaging discussions.
versions.transcriptZh:
请听学校活动上的一则通知。

同学们晚上好。年度校园电影节将于下周末举行。活动将展映多种类型的影片，包括纪录片、喜剧与剧情片。我们还将展映几部本地电影人的作品，包括一位同学的。放映在大学礼堂，星期五至星期日，每天中午开始。部分场次后还有与电影人的问答环节。希望你们加入我们，度过一个好电影与有趣讨论的周末。

versions.mediaTitle: Listen to an announcement in a classroom.
versions.transcript: Listen to an announcement in a classroom. Before we begin, I have some reminders for your research project. Remember that your paper must be between 2,000 and 2,500 words. Conferences and journals will reject your paper if it doesn't adhere to their word limits, so it's best to get into the habit now. You must also cite at least five journal articles, one of which must have been published within the last three years. Please remember also that you should submit your paper digitally via the course website. Are there any questions?
versions.transcriptZh: 请听一段教室中的通知。开始前，我对你们的研究项目有一些提醒。记住论文必须在二千至二千五百词之间。会议与期刊若论文不符合字数限制会拒稿，所以最好现在养成习惯。你们还必须至少引用五篇期刊文章，其中一篇须在过去三年内发表。也请记住应通过课程网站以数字方式提交论文。有问题吗？

Listen to an announcement at a school event.
Before we begin our film screening, I want to invite you all to the regional university debate championship on Thursday at 7:00 p.m. in the student center auditorium. We're excited to be hosting this special event for the second year in a row. Come see your very own Nordgren University debate team take on the South Melville University team. Learn new perspectives, cheer on your friends, and enjoy complimentary snacks. Registration is free. Just remember to sign up on the debate team's website soon.

versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement at a university.
The Sustainability Innovation Challenge invites student teams to solve a sustainability problem. Problems involving energy, food systems, or transportation all qualify. After identifying a specific problem and its environmental consequences, each team must propose a solution that can be piloted immediately. Proposals must include an implementation plan and budget. Faculty advisors will hold limited office hours to help teams refine their ideas, so schedule a meeting early to secure a spot.
versions.transcriptZh:
请听大学的一则通知。
“可持续创新挑战”邀请学生团队解决可持续相关问题。涉及能源、食品系统或交通的问题都符合条件。在明确具体问题及其环境后果后，每个团队须提出可立即试点的方案。提案须包含实施计划和预算。指导老师将提供有限的答疑时间帮助完善想法，请尽早预约以确保名额。

Listen to an announcement on a university radio station.
Student Activities is excited to announce a river cruise, giving graduating students a chance to bid each other farewell one last time. We will be cruising along the Pennington River on a charter boat, seeing riverfront sights while feasting on a scrumptious dinner featuring tender slow-roasted meat and seasonal vegetables bursting with flavor. An optional get-together following the cruise will take place on the famous Chancellor Avenue.

questions.promptText: What can be inferred about a planned event?

choices.label: It will be the last time together for certain students.

choices.explanationZh: 正确。给毕业生最后道别机会，即某些学生最后一次相聚。

choices.label: It will be free to students in the senior class.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。未说免费。

choices.label: It will be the last river cruise sponsored by the university.
choices.labelZh: 这将是大学赞助的最后一次河上巡游。

choices.label: It will take place over the course of a few days.

choices.label: It will include seafood.

choices.label: It will be delicious.
choices.explanationZh: 正确。scrumptious、bursting with flavor 等强调晚餐美味。

choices.label: It will be optional.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。可选的是游船后聚会。

choices.label: It will take place on a famous street.

versions.label: Wofo M32
versions.mediaTitle: Listen to an announcement at a school event.
versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement at a school event.
Students, we hope to see you tonight in Kelsey Hall at 7:00 for the Student Volunteer Club Gala. Please remember to bring donations with you for the various charities our gala supports. We're excited to announce a new partnership with a local youth sports program, so in addition to monetary donations, we will also be collecting donations of new and gently used sports equipment. When you arrive, first stop at the reception desk to check in and receive a name badge.
versions.transcriptZh:
请听学校活动上的一则通知。
同学们，我们希望今晚七点在凯尔西厅见到你们，参加学生志愿者俱乐部晚会。请记得带上为我们晚会支持的各慈善机构的捐赠。我们兴奋地宣布与本地青年体育项目的新合作，因此除金钱捐赠外，我们还将收集全新与轻度使用的体育器材捐赠。到达时先到接待台签到并领取名牌。

transcriptSentences.text: Listen to an announcement at a school event.

transcriptSentences.textZh: 同学们，我们希望今晚七点在凯尔西厅见到你们，参加学生志愿者俱乐部晚会。

transcriptSentences.textZh: 请记得带上为我们晚会支持的各慈善机构的捐赠。

transcriptSentences.text: When you arrive, first stop at the reception desk to check in and receive a name badge.
transcriptSentences.textZh: 到达时先到接待台签到并领取名牌。

questions.promptText: What type of event is the speaker describing?
questions.promptTextZh: 说话者正在描述什么类型的活动？

choices.label: A music concert.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。通篇未提音乐表演、乐器或演出环节。

choices.label: A sports match.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。虽涉及体育器材捐赠，但事件性质是‘Gala’（义卖晚会），非比赛。

choices.label: A club meeting.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。‘Student Volunteer Club Gala’是年度庆典活动，非常规例会。

choices.label: A fundraiser.
choices.explanationZh: 正确。核心动作是‘bring donations’‘monetary donations’‘donations of...sports equipment’，典型筹款活动特征。

questions.promptText: What will students receive when they arrive?
questions.promptTextZh: 学生到达后会收到什么？

choices.label: A seating assignment.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。未提及座位安排或指定位置。

choices.label: A name tag.
choices.explanationZh: 正确。原文明确‘stop at the reception desk to check in and receive a name badge’，‘name badge’即姓名标牌（姓名贴）。

choices.label: An event program.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。未提到发放节目单或流程册。

choices.label: A discount.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。全文无任何价格优惠或折扣信息。

versions.label: Wofo M32
versions.mediaTitle: Listen to an announcement in a classroom.
versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement in a classroom.

This is the final course required for your business degree. The course will operate as an independent study. You will each select an area of focus that interests you. Some examples are available on my website. Then every week, you'll be required to submit short essays that respond to questions I give you on this topic. You'll need to refer to what you've learned in your other business courses, so you can cite theories or strategies that support your responses.
versions.transcriptZh: 请听一段教室中的通知。女：如你们所知，这是商学学位要求的最后一门课。本课将以独立研究方式进行。你们每人选择一个感兴趣的聚焦领域。我的网站上有一些例子。然后每周你们需提交短文，回应我就此主题给出的问题。你们需要参照其他商学课程所学，以便引用支持你们回答的理论或策略。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Narrator
transcriptSentences.text: Listen to an announcement in a classroom.

transcriptSentences.textZh: 你们需要参照其他商学课程所学，以便引用支持你们回答的理论或策略。

questions.promptText: What is available on the speaker's website?
questions.promptTextZh: 演讲者的网站上提供了什么？

choices.label: Some topic ideas
choices.explanationZh: 上下文紧贴："select an area of focus... Some examples are available on my website"，examples 指代的是 area of focus 的示例，也就是选题方向。

choices.label: Some examples of essays
choices.explanationZh: 网站给的是 area of focus 的例子，不是写好的 essay 范文——容易因为后文出现 essays 而误选，典型的 "近距离词混淆"。

choices.label: An updated course schedule
choices.explanationZh: 课程时间表原文没提。

choices.label: A new degree requirement
choices.explanationZh: 新的学位要求没提，只说这是学位要求里的最后一门课。

questions.promptText: Where should the listeners look for theories and strategies?
questions.promptTextZh: 听众应该去哪里寻找理论和策略？

choices.label: In books assigned by the speaker
choices.labelZh: 在演讲者指定的书籍中
choices.explanationZh: 老师没指定任何阅读材料，纯属添加。

choices.label: In work from previous classes
choices.explanationZh: 原文 "refer to what you've learned in your other business courses, so you can cite theories or strategies" —— other business courses 就是 previous classes，是直接同义改写。

choices.label: In the university library
choices.explanationZh: 图书馆没出现，靠 "找资料" 思维定势容易误选。

choices.label: On an academic website
choices.explanationZh: academic website 跟老师本人的 website 不是一回事，且老师网站上是选题示例，不是理论。

versions.label: Wofo M32
versions.mediaTitle: Listen to an announcement in a classroom.
versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement in a classroom.

For your upcoming project, please write a detailed report on a topic related to environmental science. It should be about 1,500 words long and include at least two scholarly sources. Please follow the university formatting guidelines. If you have any questions, my office hours are on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Just keep in mind, my office hours on the last Thursday of this month will be moved forward a day to Wednesday, because I'll be traveling to a research symposium.
versions.transcriptZh: 请听教室中关于你们即将到来的项目的一则通知。请写一份与环境科学相关主题的详细报告。大约一千五百词，并至少包含两份学术来源。请遵循大学格式规范；如有问题……我的办公时间在星期二与星期四。请记住，本月最后一个星期四的办公时间会提前一天改到星期三，因为我将前往研究研讨会。

transcriptSentences.text: It should be about 1,500 words long and include at least two scholarly sources.

questions.promptText: What is the main purpose of the announcement?
questions.promptTextZh: 这则通知的主要目的是什么？

choices.label: To remind students of a deadline
choices.explanationZh: 整段没出现具体截止日期，谈不上 remind deadline。

choices.label: To point out the requirements for an assignment
choices.explanationZh: 三个关键要求并列：'1,500 words'、'two scholarly sources'、'university formatting guidelines'——这就是在交代 assignment requirements。

choices.label: To invite students to office hours
choices.labelZh: 邀请学生参加办公时间
choices.explanationZh: office hours 只是顺带交代答疑时间，不是公告主旨——典型的'细节出现 ≠ 主旨'陷阱。

choices.label: To discuss environmental science topics
choices.explanationZh: 老师只说选题要相关，没真讨论任何环境科学话题。

questions.promptText: Why does the speaker mention a research symposium?
questions.promptTextZh: 说话者为何提及学术研讨会？

choices.label: To recommend a topic for a report
choices.explanationZh: symposium 不是建议选题，纯属无中生有。

choices.label: To explain the need for formatting guidelines
choices.labelZh: 解释格式规范的必要性
choices.explanationZh: formatting guidelines 是独立的作业要求，与 symposium 无因果。

choices.label: To emphasize the need for scholarly sources
choices.labelZh: 强调使用学术资料的需求
choices.explanationZh: scholarly sources 同样是独立要求，没有联系到研讨会。

choices.label: To provide the reason for a schedule change
choices.explanationZh: 因果信号词 'because I'll be traveling to a research symposium'——解释 office hours 为什么提前一天，正是 schedule change 的原因。

We are happy to announce that this year's fall concert will be held on November 11th. This year's lineup of performers will provide tunes that are sure to get you out of your seat and moving to the beat. Bring a special friend or a whole group, as all are welcome. If you buy tickets online, you'll automatically be entered into the free drawing for a prize at the end of the concert.

choices.label: It is performed entirely by students.

choices.label: To gain admission before tickets sell out.

versions.label: Wofo M33
versions.mediaTitle: Listen to an announcement on a campus radio station.
versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement on a campus radio station.

Due to yesterday's heavy rain storms, a major leak has developed in the roof of the library. The campus facilities department has determined that it needs to be repaired as soon as possible to avoid damage to books and library resources. To allow for maintenance work, the library will be closed until noon on Wednesday. Some library resources will still be available online and study space will be available at the student center. The library staff apologizes for the inconvenience and appreciates your understanding.
versions.transcriptZh: 请听校园广播站的一则通知。由于昨天的暴雨，图书馆屋顶出现重大渗漏。校园设施部门已认定需尽快维修，以免损坏书籍与图书馆资源。为进行维护，图书馆将关闭至星期三中午。部分图书馆资源仍可在线获取，学生中心有学习空间。图书馆工作人员对不便表示歉意并感谢理解。

questions.promptText: Why will the library close?

choices.label: To repair a roof leak
choices.explanationZh: 因果链一目了然："major leak... in the roof" → "needs to be repaired as soon as possible" → 闭馆是为了让维修进场。

choices.label: To move books online
choices.labelZh: 为了将图书转移到线上
choices.explanationZh: 原文只说 "some library resources will still be available online"——线上仍可用，跟 "搬书上网" 不是一回事，属于截取局部词组反向解读。

choices.labelZh: 为了举办一场学生活动

choices.label: All library rooms
choices.explanationZh: 图书馆要关闭，所有房间开放与原文相反。

choices.label: Free book replacement

choices.label: A new roof tour
choices.explanationZh: 屋顶参观纯属编造。

versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement at a university.
Please come to Monday's seminar, where Dr. James Lee will share techniques to balance coursework with extracurricular activities and personal commitments. Dr. Lee's passion for this began during his undergraduate years, when he double majored in psychology and biology. At the same time, he did nighttime shifts as a hospital records clerk, which made getting enough sleep difficult. The challenge of balancing studying, work, and personal well-being sparked his lifelong interest in time management, which he now teaches to students and professionals across the country.

Good morning, senior class. Starting next semester, all graduating students must complete a professional development workshop before receiving their diplomas. This requirement ensures you are equipped with essential career skills, including resume writing, interview preparation, and networking strategies. Sessions will be available throughout the semester, but they may fill up fast, so plan ahead and sign up early. Check the university website for details on scheduling and registration. Your future success starts with preparation.

versions.transcript:
Listen to a campus radio announcement.
We've had some security issues recently, and so on Monday, all students and staff will be required to set new passwords with more robust requirements than the current ones. Passwords will need to be changed once a month going forward, and remember, do not share your password with anyone else, as this has caused some recent problems. We will never ask for your password or other confidential information via email, so if you receive emails along those lines, please delete them.

请听校园广播通知。
我们最近有一些安全问题，因此在星期一，所有学生与职员将被要求设置比当前要求更严格的新密码。今后密码需每月更改一次，并记住，不要与任何人分享密码，因为这已造成一些近期问题。我们绝不会通过邮件索要你的密码或其他机密信息，因此若收到此类邮件，请删除。

versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement at a university club meeting.

Attention club members. We wanted to make you aware of the new attendance policy that will be implemented starting next month due to ongoing issues with excessive absences. We will now require all members to attend at least 75% of the meetings each term to maintain their membership. Failure to comply may result in dismissal from the club. Allowances will be made for extenuating circumstances, and members can appeal a dismissal. Please visit our website to view the full policy.

Hello, students. Our end of semester celebration is next Friday at 6:00 pm in the student lounge. It's a great chance to relax before finals week. We'll have food, music, and a few games and activities, including trivia and a raffle with small prizes. Faculty from several departments will be there, too, so it's a great opportunity to connect with instructors outside of class. We still need a few volunteers to help set up before the event. If interested, please contact the student activities coordinator by Wednesday.

versions.label: Wofo M39
versions.mediaTitle: Listen to an announcement in a classroom.
versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement in a classroom.

I have some updates regarding the schedule for your upcoming assignments. The deadline for your research paper has been extended to next Friday, giving you an extra week to incorporate my feedback on your outline. Additionally, the date for your group presentations has been moved to the following Monday to allow you more time to practice. These changes are intended to help reduce stress during a busy part of the semester. If you have questions, visit me during office hours or send me an email.
versions.transcriptZh: 请听一段教室中的通知。教授就即将到来的作业截止日期给出更新。研究论文截止日期已延长，以便学生纳入提纲反馈；小组报告改到接下来的星期一，以便学生有更多时间练习。教授说这些变更旨在减轻学期繁忙阶段的压力。

choices.label: Submit a research paper

choices.label: Give a group presentation
choices.explanationZh: group presentation 推到 'the following Monday'，不是周五。典型的张冠李戴。

choices.label: Attend a seminar
choices.explanationZh: 整段没提 seminar。

choices.label: Prepare an outline

versions.mediaTitle: Listen to an announcement in a university classroom.
versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement in a university classroom.

Since a lot of you have expressed an interest in a career in education once you've graduated, I thought I'd share something that I think will be very helpful to you. It's a list of professional organizations and networking opportunities for aspiring new teachers. I've attached a copy with an email I sent everyone just before class. If you're one of the students I'm referring to, I highly recommend you check it out.
versions.transcriptZh: 请听一段教室中的通知。教授告诉对教育职业感兴趣的学生，他分享了一份对有志新教师有用的专业组织与社交机会清单。他在课前发给所有人的邮件中附了一份，并强烈建议感兴趣的学生查看。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Narrator
transcriptSentences.text: Listen to an announcement in a university classroom.
transcriptSentences.textZh: 请听一段教室中的通知。

transcriptSentences.text: Since a lot of you have expressed an interest in a career in education once you've graduated, I thought I'd share something that I think will be very helpful to you.
transcriptSentences.textZh: 既然很多同学表示毕业后想从事教育，我想分享一样我觉得对你们很有帮助的东西。

transcriptSentences.text: It's a list of professional organizations and networking opportunities for aspiring new teachers.
transcriptSentences.textZh: 这是一份给有志新教师的专业组织与社交机会清单。

transcriptSentences.textZh: 上课前我给大家发的邮件里附了一份。

transcriptSentences.textZh: 如果你就是我说的这类学生，我强烈建议你看一看。

questions.promptText: What is the purpose of the announcement?
questions.promptTextZh: 这则通知的目的是什么？

choices.label: To recommend a book about networking
choices.labelZh: 推荐一本关于人际网络的书
choices.explanationZh: 教授分享的是一份 "list"，不是一本书；偷换了载体。

choices.label: To inform students about a list of resources
choices.labelZh: 告知学生一份资源清单
choices.explanationZh: 对应 "a list of professional organizations and networking opportunities"——这就是一份资源清单，主旨就是把它告诉想当老师的同学。

choices.label: To emphasize the importance of a career in education
choices.labelZh: 强调教育职业的重要性
choices.explanationZh: 通篇没强调教育职业有多重要，只是顺手分享资源。

choices.label: To explain the process of joining professional organizations
choices.labelZh: 解释加入专业组织的流程
choices.explanationZh: 原文没讲怎么加入这些组织，只是给了清单——把 "提供清单" 升级成 "讲流程" 属于细节夸大。

questions.promptText: What does the professor imply when he says, "I’ve attached a copy with an email I sent everyone just before class"?
questions.promptTextZh: 教授说“我在课前发给每个人的邮件里附了一份副本”时，他暗示了什么？

choices.label: Students are able to access a document.
choices.labelZh: 学生可以获取一份文件。
choices.explanationZh: "attached a copy with an email" 的言外之意就是同学可以打开邮箱拿到这份附件，对应 "access a document"。

choices.label: He cannot meet with students before class.
choices.labelZh: 他无法在课前与学生见面。
choices.explanationZh: 讲的是邮件附件，不是说自己课前没空见学生，跟 meeting 无关。

choices.label: Students should check their email regularly.
choices.labelZh: 学生应该定期查看电子邮件。
choices.explanationZh: 他没有泛泛地建议常查邮件，只是提了这一次的资料在邮件里——把单次行为上升成习惯建议是常见过度推断。

choices.label: Emails are his preferred method of communication.
choices.labelZh: 电子邮件是他偏好的沟通方式。
choices.explanationZh: 没说邮件是他偏好的沟通方式，只是这一次用了邮件。

versions.mediaTitle: Listen to an announcement in a campus dormitory.
versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement in a campus dormitory.
Attention residents of Parkview Hall. As outlined in your housing agreement, noise should be kept to a minimum after 10:00 p.m. on weekdays and 11:00 p.m. on weekends. This includes playing loud music, hosting parties, or engaging in other noisy activities. If complaints continue at their current pace, stricter enforcement measures will be introduced, such as citations and fines. Please be considerate of your neighbors. Following these guidelines helps make Parkview Hall a respectful community. Thank you.

请听校园宿舍的一则通知。
Parkview 楼住户请注意。如住房协议所述，工作日晚上十点后、周末晚上十一点后噪音应保持最低。这包括大声播放音乐、举办派对或从事其他嘈杂活动。若投诉以当前速度继续，将引入更严格的执行措施，如传票与罚款。请体谅邻居。遵守这些指南有助使 Parkview 楼成为相互尊重的社区。谢谢。

Listen to an announcement in a classroom.

Good morning students. I have an important update regarding our classroom facilities. Starting next Monday, we will be using the university's new digital attendance system. You must scan your student ID card at the lecture hall entrance to record your presence. This system will help streamline and accurately track attendance records. Please be sure to bring your student ID to every lecture. If you encounter any issues with the scanner, notify me immediately, so we can address it.

The Sustainability Innovation Challenge invites student teams to solve a sustainability problem. Problems involving energy, food systems, or transportation all qualify. After identifying a specific problem and its environmental consequences, each team must propose a solution that can be piloted immediately. Proposals must include an implementation plan and budget. Faculty advisors will hold limited office hours to help teams refine their ideas, so schedule a meeting early to secure a spot.

versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement at a student club meeting.
Welcome to the inaugural meeting of our university's first pickleball club. I'm Robbie Vincent, volunteer president. Alex Rivera is our vice president. We still need a treasurer and secretary. Let me know if you're interested. Club officers serve for one academic year. We've reserved the four outdoor courts near the recreation center for 5:00 to 6:30 on Tuesdays and Thursdays, weather permitting. Intermediate pickleballers get the Tuesday slot, and advanced players get Thursdays. Eventually, we'll admit beginners and recruit volunteers to teach them.

请听学生社团会议上的一则通知。
欢迎参加本校第一个匹克球俱乐部的成立大会。我是志愿主席 Robbie Vincent。Alex Rivera 是我们的副主席。我们还需要一名财务和一名秘书。有兴趣的请告诉我。社团干部任期为一个学年。我们已预订了休闲中心附近的四块室外场地，周二和周四下午 5:00 到 6:30，天气允许时使用。中级球员用周二时段，高级球员用周四。以后我们会招收初学者，并招募志愿者来教他们。

The Writing Center is seeking entries for its tenth annual Creative Writing Competition. The competition's theme this year is alternative realities. Writers should take this opportunity to base their entries on perspectives, narratives, or literary genres that they do not usually work in and that are outside their comfort zones. An original poem, short story, or work of creative nonfiction may be submitted. The deadline is November 30. Selected by faculty judges, winners get cash prizes and have their work published in the University Literary Journal. Check the Writing Center's website for details.

Listen to an announcement about a dormitory meeting on noise regulations.
We're hosting a meeting this Thursday at 7 p.m. to discuss the new noise regulations in our dormitory. These rules aim to reduce disturbances during study hours and late at night, especially in shared spaces. This meeting is a chance for you to voice your opinions, ask questions, and suggest improvements. Your feedback is important in creating a respectful and peaceful living environment. We hope you'll attend and help shape the policy. Light refreshments will be provided, and all residents are encouraged to join.

请听一则关于宿舍噪音规定会议的通知。
我们将在本周四晚上7点召开会议，讨论宿舍新的噪音规定。这些规定旨在减少学习时段和深夜、尤其是公共区域的干扰。这次会议是你表达意见、提问并提出改进建议的机会。你的反馈对营造尊重、安静的居住环境很重要。希望你能参加并帮助完善政策。会提供简单茶点，欢迎所有住宿生参加。

Listen to an announcement in a classroom.
Your third essay, due March 1, involves comparing and contrasting two books—Toni Morrison's Beloved and George Orwell's 1984—with attention to the authors' thematic choices, structural styles, and symbolism.
You're encouraged to incorporate viewpoints of literary critics to strengthen your argument.
However, these sources must adhere to standard citation guidelines.
You'll find the citation guidelines in our interactive syllabus.
This essay should not exceed 2,000 words.
Please give yourself sufficient time. Rushing could result in missing key analytical points.

鼓励你们引用文学评论家的观点来加强论证。

versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement at a student club meeting.
The Creative Writing Club has a challenge for students.
We want you to write amazing stories, but they must be under 700 words.
Every submission must have a beginning, middle, and ending.
Judging will be based on originality, writing quality, emotional impact, and technical skill.
Winning entries with the greatest emotional impact will be published in the university's literary magazine.
Winners will also get a gift card.
For details, visit the Creative Writing Club's webpage.

情感感染力最强的获奖作品将刊登在学校的文学杂志上。
获奖者还将获得礼品卡。
详情请访问创意写作俱乐部的网站。

Students, before your anthropological field study, you must complete an online training module.
This mini-course covers getting permission from participants, organizing research materials, and citing previous work.
The mini-course takes about two hours and must be completed by October 1st, even if your fieldwork doesn't start until later in the term.
Those who don't complete the mini-course by the deadline will have their fieldwork postponed until next term, which will affect their grade in this course.

未能在截止日期前完成短课程的学生，其实地研究将推迟到下学期，这会影响他们在本课程中的成绩。

The University's Work-Study Initiative has been redesigned to provide financial assistance while enhancing your professional development.
This initiative pairs students with relevant campus departments or professional organizations, enabling them to gain valuable work experience aligned with their career pursuits.
Successful applicants, notably those maintaining satisfactory academic performance, can expect flexible work hours tailored to their individual needs.
Applications will be accepted until next Friday at 5 p.m.

该计划会将学生安排到相关的校内部门或专业组织，使他们获得与职业目标相符的宝贵工作经验。

The university's parking permit system is going all digital. Current parking permit holders should already have received an email with a link to the system and instructions. versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement at a university library.
Attention students. To address issues brought up by patrons, the University Library will now require you to present your University ID when entering the building. This change is occurring based on feedback from staff and students. Additionally, the library's computer workstations are changing from username and password access to ID card access. Get ready to travel the world without leaving campus. Join us for Cultural Night. Our students showcase the music, dance, food, and traditions of countries from across the globe. Explore vibrant booths, enjoy live performances, and taste authentic dishes all in one unforgettable evening. It's a celebration of diversity, community, and global connections. Just email me to let me know you're not on campus and wish to meet, and I'll write back and let you know if I can accommodate you.

versions.mediaTitle: Listen to an announcement at a university faculty event.
versions.transcript:
Listen to an announcement at a university faculty event.
Our department's planning committee has decided to host this year's Digital Arts Symposium virtually rather than on campus. This format change will allow us to include renowned speakers from across the globe, including Dr. Naomi Costa of Nepal University. Dr. Costa promises to unveil her latest research findings during her keynote speech. Then, attendees will choose among eight virtual breakout sessions, including some focusing on the intersection between art and digital media.
versions.transcriptZh:
请听大学教职工活动中的一则通知。
我们系的筹备委员会决定，今年的数字艺术研讨会将在线上举行，而不在校园内举办。这种形式变化让我们能够邀请全球各地的知名演讲者参加，其中包括 Nepal University 的 Naomi Costa 博士。Costa 博士将于主旨演讲中公布她最新的研究成果。随后，与会者可以从八场线上分组研讨中选择参加，其中一些将聚焦艺术与数字媒体的交汇领域。

versions.transcript: I know many of you have started gathering sources for the research assignment that's due later this month. versions.transcript: Before we finish today, I want to remind you about the weekly paper for this course. Each week, you'll write a short response based on the assigned reading. Your paper should be uploaded through the course portal by five o'clock every Friday. I'll read the papers over the weekend and return comments early the following week. Also, if you come across an argument or passage in the reading that you don't understand, please talk to me. You can stay for a few minutes after class or come to my office hours. I'd rather answer a question about the reading before you write than have you base your paper on a misunderstanding.
